plugins.name: Deep AI Summary
plugins.description: AI summary panel with full-page fetching: the top results' pages are fetched server side and offered to the model as primary evidence, with per-page caps, timeouts and an optional external extractor. Forked from the official AI Summary plugin; also adds a custom panel title and max-sources setting.
